title: Data-Topology Compatibility Enables Personalization in Decentralized Learning
abstract: arXiv:2610.15126v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Decentralized learning must balance collaboration with personalization across heterogeneous agents. This paper studies when cooperation can support statistically coherent groups of personalized models. We show that data-topology compatibility enables robust orbit-wise personalization: when local objectives and communication topology have (approximately) compatible automorphisms, agents within an orbit share (approximately) equal limiting distributions, while different orbits remain distinct without explicit personalization. This creates a new intermediate regime between global consensus and independent local learning. Under exact data-topology compatibility, as a reference system, we decompose the stochastic learning dynamics into orbit-level and transverse components, derive a necessary and sufficient stability criterion for distributional synchronization, and characterize the orbit-structured stationary law. translated_title: 数据-拓扑兼容性使去中心化学习中的个性化成为可能
translated_abstract: 去中心化学习必须在异质智能体之间平衡协作与个性化。本文研究了协作何时能够支持统计上连贯的个性化模型群体。我们证明了数据-拓扑兼容性能够实现鲁棒的轨道级个性化：当局部目标函数与通信拓扑具有（近似）兼容的自同构时，同一轨道内的智能体共享（近似）相同的极限分布，而不同轨道则保持彼此独立，无需显式的个性化机制。这在全局共识与独立局部学习之间创造了一种新的中间状态。在精确数据-拓扑兼容性的条件下，作为一个参考系统，我们将随机学习动力学分解为轨道级分量与横向分量，推导出分布同步的充分必要稳定性判据，并刻画了具有轨道结构的平稳律。对近似数据的建模……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出数据-拓扑兼容性理论，证明当局部目标与通信拓扑具有近似兼容的自同构时，同一轨道内的智能体无需显式个性化即可自动收敛到相同的个性化分布，从而在全局共识与独立学习之间建立了新的中间机制。
en_tdlr: This paper shows that data-topology compatibility—when local objectives and communication topology have (approximately) compatible automorphisms—enables robust orbit-wise personalization, establishing a new intermediate regime between global consensus and independent local learning.
